Guidance & outlook: Coming to our “Financial Performance.” For FY2026, our standalone total income grew by 57.36% year-on-year to Rs.689.95 crores, while EBITDA increased by 19.41% to Rs.84.79 crores, and net profit rose by 42.11% to Rs.71.31 crores.
So, we are expecting this year, inclusive all products and new geometry, we will achieve 50% of capacity utilization from new facility.

And I believe that given the fact that we are targeting such a huge growth and based on your numbers like say at Rs.2,250 crores revenue we may be generating roughly around Rs.350 crores of cash profit by the time we achieve that particular revenue target.
Growth & demand: For Q4 2026 FY, standalone total income grew by 55.06% year-on-year to Rs.204.93 crores, with net profit rising by 22.69% to Rs.16.87 crores.
So, that is the main reason we will have revenue from the new products as well as from fin and tube for existing customer growth and also new customer growth.

So, like I can be able to maybe new products including complete bus air conditioning and then existing customer growth and plus new customer growth, and of course export what I said we are going to achieve almost double within this year.
Margins & costs: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at Rs.609.81 crores, up 38.06% year-on-year, with EBITDA growing by 59.52% to Rs.112.48 crores, and net profit increasing by 44.62% to Rs.76.47 crores.
On the consolidated side, total income came in at Rs.181.40 crores, up 33.5% year-on-year, while EBITDA increased by 77.56% to Rs.33.55 crores, and net profit rose by 57.14% to Rs.23.36 crores.
We already cracked the two, three OEMs and our regular supply has already started and we are in line on 15% of the market utilization.
Capex & expansion: So, new capacity, if you see like including all products, so we call like our old facility to 6x.
And for HVAC, we are able to, I think, utilize around 15% only, but this year, we are planning to achieve 50% from new facility as well, and KRN Heat will remain same.
Lastly, our entire CAPEX is now over, so the capacity like the 6x existing capacity so all that is done now nothing left on the CAPEX side.
Balance sheet & cash: As the new plant stamps up further, we expect operating leverage to start playing clearly.
Just on the working capital side, sir, I know we have accumulated a lot of inventory, almost 3x versus last year, and receivables are also 1x or 2x versus last year.
And secondly on the working capital side like say I believe that at Rs.2,250 crores at the lower range of the revenue, we would be requiring roughly around Rs.600 crores of working capital.
Risks & challenges: On the operations side, we have stayed focused on execution, whether it is managing raw material volatility, improving efficiency, or working on backward integration.
